company_profile.summary: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd is India's largest electronic manufacturing services (EMS) company. Functioning as the premier design and manufacturing partner for global smartphone, consumer electronics, and appliance brands, Dixon produces mobile phones (Motorola, Xiaomi, Transsion), LED televisions, washing machines, telecom hardware, and security surveillance systems under the Government of India's PLI schemes.

revenue_breakup.desc: Contract manufacturing of 5G/4G smartphones and feature phones for marquee global brands.
Assembly of LED televisions, smart display boards, and commercial visual monitors.
Semi-automatic and fully-automatic top-load washing machines.
LED bulbs, battens, downlights, and smart lighting driver electronics.
5G modems, routers, set-top boxes, and CCTV security cameras.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India - OEM/ODM Clients): 92% • Global Electronics Exports: 8%
moats_and_strengths: #1 Indian EMS player with immense scale advantages, producing nearly 35% of all LED TVs sold in India.
Primary beneficiary of the Government of India's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes across smartphones, telecom, and IT hardware.
Long-term anchor partnerships with global brand giants (Motorola, Xiaomi, Samsung, Panasonic, boAt).
Asset-light ODM model delivering high capital turnover and return on capital employed (ROCE > 26%).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Manufacturing Capacity: 23 manufacturing facilities • Annual Capacity > 45M smartphones and 6M televisions

bullish_triggers: Export ramp-up of Motorola and Transsion smartphones from India to North America and Europe.
Commissioning of IT hardware PLI manufacturing lines for global laptop and tablet brands.
Backward integration into display modules, camera modules, and precision mechanical enclosures.
bearish_risks: Contract manufacturing customer concentration risk where top 3 clients contribute over 50% of revenue.
Thin operating EBITDA margins (~3.5%–4.2%) vulnerable to supply chain component pricing pressures.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
